g.title: flashcli_flow
g.text: resolve ref → local cache / FlashHub sync → weights / venv → inference inside the bundle

g.title: manifest
g.text: local manifest, or download only flashcli-bundle.json

g.title: ensure
g.text: force is always false; run/serve never call host.Pull

g.title: sync
g.text: selected runtime cell + common files only
MD5 verify; write runtime / bundle markers

g.title: err_manifest
g.text: missing file, protocol, env key, variant, entry

g.title: preflight
g.text: recognize native .so in the runtime cell

g.title: err_env
g.text: no NVIDIA GPU or no matching cell

g.title: weights
g.text: allow / require patterns + norm stats readiness

g.title: native_exec
g.text: start the bundle executable after weights

g.title: cuda
g.text: headers rechecked with the real interpreter

g.title: offline
g.text: run/serve are local-first: no network when the bundle marker, complete weights and venv fingerprint all match
network only for missing artifacts, explicit pull, or a schema upgrade

g.title: script
g.text: no host routes; manifest env is not applied

g.title: ne_http
g.text: http: print endpoint, wait for signal
host does not proxy; clients connect directly

g.title: abi_plain
g.text: run probes the ABI and prints JSON
